children: uniQure submitted a BLA to the FDA requesting accelerated approval and an MAA to the MHRA for ifezuntirgene inilparvovec (AMT-130), supported by three-year Phase I/II data showing slowed disease progression.
Submitted BLA to FDA requesting accelerated approval for AMT-130; company also filed MAA with the U.K. MHRA.
Both submissions are supported by three-year Phase I/II analysis versus a propensity score-matched external control.
Company has requested priority review for the BLA, which would shorten FDA review to six months after the 60-day filing review.
AMT-130 holds FDA Breakthrough Therapy, RMAT, and Fast Track designations, underscoring regulatory support.
